profile.headline: Firmware Engineer at Full Swing Golf
profile.summary: Experienced (10+ years) Embedded Software Engineer skilled in developing real-time applications. Proficient in C/C++, embedded Linux, FPGA interfaces,and cross-platform development. Ready to apply advanced technical skills and collaborative problem-solving to drive innovation.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in a multi-disciplined team comprised of Firmware, DevOps, and Algorithm Engineers. Responsible for the embedded C++ application, including the FPGA interface and Main UI board interface for the Launch Monitor (LM) Baseball and LM Multisport projects.
- Build Architecture - Designed and ported a monolithic embedded Git repository into a multi-tiered structure to maximize generic code reuse and platform portability.
- Embedded Development - Integrated a common embedded C++ Shared Object library with sport specific C++ application, enabling runtime sport-specific code switching across the Multisport product line.
- Build Tooling - Implemented modern development infrastructure including CMake build systems, Docker Development Environments, GitHub CI Actions, and GTest automated unit testing.
- FPGA Interface - helped design and implement a thread safe, platform abstracted interface for the FPGA. Additionally, tasked developers in the implementation of PeakRDL for automated FPGA-software interface generation.
- Project Work - Collaborated on product requirements and conducted live demos for investors.
- Other - Provided support for other projects including the Tomorrow Golf League (TGL), featured on ESPN.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on MAC Layer 2 networking driver for Software Controlled Radios as part of several products and waveforms including TSM, WREN-TSM, WREN-NB, and Katana.
- Real-Time Controls – C/C++ Development of software network drivers for Mobile Ad Hoc TDMA Network.
- FPGA – Updated MAC Board Support Packages for FPGA register mappings and functionality.
- Encryption – Implemented and integrated NSA compliant self-test package for AES-256 encryption.
- Radio Test – Implemented user togglable radio-mode to allow automated network wide Bit Error Rate Test for profiling waveform performance.
- Software Unit Test – Regularly updated unit test suite with simulation and Boost-unit-test as part of Regression.
- Customer Demo – Supported multiple field tests and customer demo with custom software builds and debug support.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Combined experience in Software Development and Hardware Engineering. Contributed to numerous projects and groups including Railgun, Advanced Arresting Gear (AAG), Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS), and Radiation Monitoring.
- Led multidisciplinary team in interfacing with the customer on software feature process to gather requirements for software delivery as well as updating and processing all technical documentation for proposed changes. Implemented novel compressed format, reducing cycle time, which is now standard procedure.
- Led team in overhauling and standardizing Unit Test, Design Documentation, Smoke Test, and Software Tracker framework for the AAG Control System. This Increased software traceability and streamlined the various teams efforts for our CSCI. As a result, our group reduced the number of Bugs and Test Observations found versus previous releases and shortened its Feature, Regression, and Integration Test schedules by weeks.
- Led Prototyping teams in developing Real Time Control Test Enclosures for use in labs. Developed entire systems including circuits, enclosure design, fabrication, software, and test validation. This resulted in added functionality and reduced test schedules.
- Developed Software and Controls Group Smoke Test prior to Test Team release.
- Developed Real-Time Controls: Applications and Drivers in C/C++ for  AAG Control System and EMALS Power System.
- Responsible for Software Architecture design and implementation.
- Performed Full Stack Web Development for test tools on internal network and for labs.

positions.title: Hardware Technician
positions.description:
Worked as Hardware Technician on MOCA embedded systems for cable set-top box conversion of Analog to Digital signals over RF Coaxial Cable for Whole House DVR.
- Circuit Design
- PCB Debugging and Failure Analysis
- Hardware Test
- Test Tool Design and Implementation
